title: In this town, your coat changes colour when you change your mind
description:
In this town, every coat is one clear colour, and it slowly fades to a new one whenever its wearer changes their mind. My sister Pip's coat has been every colour there is this week. Mine has been white my whole life.

Then one foggy Sunday at the car-boot sale, her coat is lying on our stall without her, still changing colour by itself. And somebody is sitting in her chair.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What colour would your coat be right now?
